_doc: Forest base dressing (Update 3): physics props in the main building (spawn asleep, wake on touch), readable notes, cleanable grime decals. Unity metres; p/q = pose of the item model origin (bottom centre). clean = counts for the cleaning task (into a TrashBag / the bin), kind: trash | prop | tool | paper. Texts: Forest_Notes.json. Decals: square quad of side size in the local XZ plane of q, 4 mm over the floor (in p), normal local +Y, u along local -X, v along local -Z (corner (+h, +h) = (u0, v0), h = size / 2), material M_BV_Decal (alpha cut-out).
